description: Use this when the user asks what one perfumery material smells like, how it is used, how strong or long-lasting it is, or how much of it IFRA allows (its Category 4 fine-fragrance limit, e.g. "how much Iso E Super can I use"). Returns the odour description, family, note, impact, blotter life, synonyms, whether IFRA restricts it and its limit, whether the EU prohibits it, and a link to start a formula with it. The limit is the regulatory ceiling in the finished product, not a recommended dose. Without an exact match it returns the closest catalog names. To check a whole formula use check_formula.

name.description: Canonical name, synonym or CAS number.
